maddeler.e:
استخبروا (form X)
# اِسْتَخْبَرُوا (istaḵbarū) /is.tax.ba.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَخْبَرَ (istaḵbara)
# اُسْتُخْبِرُوا (ustuḵbirū) /us.tux.bi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَخْبَرَ (istaḵbara)
# اِسْتَخْبِرُوا (istaḵbirū) /is.tax.bi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَخْبَرَ (istaḵbara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
